securityBoundaries: Native API recursive cleanup accepts only the canonical output or a realpath-validated, non-symlinked, randomly owned generator directory beneath the system temporary root; every path component is checked with lstat before removal.
Native API verifier and generator working-directory cleanup revalidate random ownership markers and unlink swapped symlinks without recursively following them.
The npm staging lane requires GitHub OIDC, rejects NODE_AUTH_TOKEN and NPM_TOKEN, and grants stage publication without direct publication authority.

Published evidence is allowlisted, hash-bound to source and receipt bytes, verified against a content-addressed Git blob available in depth-one and squash-merge checkouts, stripped of metadata, and excludes internal paths, secrets, blank captures, and icon-sized images.

A standardized documentation evidence certification receipt binds each asset ID to its exact source path and SHA-256, scenario set, execution-receipt path and SHA-256, and certification label; missing, duplicate, extra, or mismatched bindings fail generation.

Native, evidence, and packed-TypeDoc output replacement uses shared ancestor-aware containment checks; canonical partial native generation is prohibited so a combined manifest cannot re-sign stale output from the omitted toolchain.

The local certification server treats request URLs as untrusted input, returns 400 for malformed encoding without terminating, and realpath-validates selected files beneath the build root before opening them.
unresolvedLimits: The public GitHub Pages URL is not deployed until this branch is reviewed, merged to protected main, and the Pages workflow succeeds.
Public-origin route probes, accessibility checks, visual checks, and Lighthouse results remain pending until that deployment exists.

GitHub Pages has no repository-local pre-production promotion or automatic rollback lane. Local built-artifact gates prevent known code defects before upload; post-deploy probes detect hosting-specific failures after publication.
The repository homepage cannot be updated truthfully until the Pages URL responds successfully.
